KEYSVILLE CHRISTMAS PARADE
PARADE GUIDELINES & JUDGING CRITERIA
PARADE DAY RULES & LOGISTICS
• Evening Lighted Parade: This is an evening parade; therefore, festive lighted decorations are essential on all entries
(vehicles, floats, marching groups, etc.). Overall design, decorations, and seasonal lighting factor heavily into all judging scales.
• Strict 'No Santa' Clause: You are not allowed to include a live Santa Claus in your individual entry. The official parade
Santa will ride exclusively at the very end of the parade layout. We strictly enforce this to avoid confusing children.
• Strict 'No Horns or Sirens' Rule: To allow attendees to hear musical talent, singing ensembles, and bands, please do not
blow any loud vehicle horns or trigger emergency sirens anywhere from the line-up zone through to the end of the route.
• Candy Policy: For safety reasons, you are permitted to toss candy safely downward toward curbside spectators. Avoid
launching pieces far into crowds or drawing children into active vehicle lanes.
• Line-Up & Route Info: Entry staging begins promptly at the Wayland Nursing Home grounds and continues systematically
onto King Street, Mary Knoll Lane, and Southern Drive. Note that Southern Drive will be converted to one-way traffic entering via the lower end (Ontario direction).
• On-Site Personnel: Numbered stakes will mark pre-assigned lane deployment positions. Volunteer firemen will be
working throughout the area—please follow their instructions implicitly.
• Judges' Stand Stop: When your entry reaches the main grandstand, please come to a brief stop for a few minutes. The
panel of judges requires a brief window to properly view, evaluate, and score your setup.
OFFICIAL JUDGING CRITERIA (0 - 5 POINT SCALE)
Entries wishing to be evaluated will be graded on a comprehensive 0 to 5 point scale by our panel across the metrics outlined below:
Bands / Marching Units Vehicles, Big Rigs & Tractors Floats (All Categories)

• Musical content & ability                 • General vehicle appearance                    • Adherence to holiday theme
• Uniforms & appearance                     • Overall cleanliness                           • Creativity & uniqueness
• Precision marching alignment              • Seasonal decorations & lighting               • Costumes match selected theme
• Drill or specialty routines               • Creative use of music/lights                  • Integration of lights & music
Thank you for abiding by these guidelines to help keep everyone safe and have an enjoyable parade!
